description: The bar chart titled “Average Entropy Across Sycophancy Reduction Methods on Static Experiments” illustrates average entropy values for different sycophancy-reduction methods across three AI models. The horizontal axis contains the categorical groups labeled “GPT-4,” “Claude,” and “Llama” (left to right) under the axis label “Different AI Models,” while the vertical axis is a linear scale labeled “Entropy Average Values,” ranging from 3.0 to 6.0 with tick marks at 0.5 intervals. Each model category contains three adjacent bars corresponding to the legend in the upper right: “Baseline” (muted purple), “Source Info” (tan), and “Direct Command” (blue-gray). For GPT-4, the Baseline bar is just under 4.9, the Source Info bar is around 5.2, and the Direct Command bar is about 5.0. For Claude, the Baseline bar is around 4.7, the Source Info bar is near 5.1, and the Direct Command bar is just under 4.95. For Llama, the Baseline bar is around 4.55, the Source Info bar is just under 5.0 (about 4.95), and the Direct Command bar is around 4.8. The bars are grouped by model rather than sorted by value, and there are no visible annotations or special visual emphasis beyond the color-coding and legend.
